package.description: Multi-repo x multi-agent control tower for AI-assisted coding.

en-US.description: Multi-repo x multi-agent control tower for AI-assisted coding.
en-US.longDescription:
OpenCherry is an open source, Ubuntu/GNOME-first desktop app that orchestrates
many Git repositories across many AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode,
Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider, ...) from a single VS Code Source Control-style
interface.
en-US.name: OpenCherry Desktop
